quick_facts.label: What the job is
quick_facts.value: Financial and investment analysts conduct quantitative analyses of information involving investment programmes or financial data.

quick_facts.label: Other names for it
quick_facts.value: Job titles O*NET reports for this occupation (Financial and Investment Analysts) include Financial Analyst, Planning Analyst, Investment Analyst and Equity Research Analyst.

quick_facts.label: Typical preparation
quick_facts.value: O*NET places this occupation in Job Zone Four (considerable preparation needed): most of these occupations require a four-year bachelor's degree, but some do not.

sections.heading: What a financial analyst does
paragraphs: Financial and investment analysts conduct quantitative analyses of information involving investment programmes or financial data.

The tasks below are taken from the O*NET profile for Financial and Investment Analysts. O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Analyse the financial or operational performance of companies to identify or recommend remedies.
Advise on aspects of capitalisation, such as amounts, sources and timing.
Work on projects with other professionals such as lawyers and accountants.
